# ponte_scim_target (Resource)

A system Ponte pushes its agents to over SCIM. Only enabled changes in place; a changed name, URL or credential replaces the target. Destroy removes the target and its stored credential.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "iga_scim_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

resource "ponte_scim_target" "iga" {
  name         = "IGA"
  base_url     = "https://iga.example.com/scim/v2"
  bearer_token = var.iga_scim_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `base_url` (String) The target's SCIM base URL (https), without a trailing slash.
- `bearer_token` (String, Sensitive) The bearer credential Ponte presents to the target. Ponte keeps it in its secret store and never returns it, so a change made outside Terraform is not detected. It is stored in the Terraform state: keep the state encrypted.
- `name` (String) Up to 80 characters.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) false stops pushes to the target without removing it.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The target id (scimtg_…).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By the target id. The credential is never returned: the first apply after the import records
# the configured one without replacing the target.
terraform import ponte_scim_target.iga scimtg_AbCdEfGhIjKl
```
